{
  "diagnosis": "Observed defects: terrain is visually flat and monotonous, lacking strategic relief and visual hierarchy. No visible asymmetry or broad landform variation. Material is uniformly grey-beige, creating camouflage-like patches. No macro-scale meadow variation or dry grass transitions. No terrain join or ground contact visible. No visual unity or composition. Mobile rendering cost is low but visual legibility is poor.",
  "design_intent": "Introduce 2-3 broad asymmetric hillside/basin forms to establish readable relief and visual hierarchy. Use restrained olive-green meadow with subtle dry grass transitions. Preserve existing painted route-centre mask. Avoid flat tint, grey, neon or beige. Use sRGB palettes with G>=R and G>B+30. Preserve prior terrain work and protected city pad. No changes to another owner's general studio code, no parameter rewriting, no model training.",
  "palette_srgb": {
    "meadow": [0, 0, 0],
    "meadow_light": [0, 0, 0],
    "dry": [0, 0, 0],
    "soil": [0, 0, 0],
    "rock": [0, 0, 0],
    "path": [0, 0, 0]
  },
